name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, TLS certificates, security settings, firewall rules, fail2ban, sysctl configuration, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, runtime directories, logging, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
